changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE club_records ADD CONSTRAINT ck_club_financial_loans CHECK (CASE WHEN financial_loans_hex IS NOT NULL AND financial_loan_clock IS NOT NULL THEN MOD(LENGTH(financial_loans_hex),56)=0 AND LENGTH(financial_loans_hex)<=28672 AND kind='CLUB' ELSE financial_loans_hex IS NULL AND financial_loan_clock IS NULL END)

rollback.sql: SELECT 1 / CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM club_records WHERE financial_loans_hex IS NOT NULL OR financial_loan_clock IS NOT NULL)=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
ALTER TABLE club_records DROP CONSTRAINT ck_club_financial_loans
